title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-16
source: flac16: Recorded, Transferred and Mastered by N. Hoey 2 Nakamichi CM 300 > Sony TC D-5m (Dolby B)(Maxell UDXL-IIS 90) (lower loge) Nakamichi Dragon (Dolby B decoded) > RME PAD 96(A/D conversion) > Apple G4 (Peak editing) > Xact

ai_review.summary: Peggy‑O and Terrapin moments shine in a high‑energy show, but the audience tape’s Dolby B quirks keep the recording only fair.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its smoking energy – especially the standout performances of "Terrapin Station," "Althea" and a delightful "Peggy‑O."  However, listeners note that this is an audience capture on a Nakamichi NAK300 with Dolby B encoding, giving it a slightly choked‑off sound and hiss that some find distracting.  Overall the show is enjoyable, but the technical limitations keep the recording from being pristine.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is rated high (smoking performance, notable songs) while recording quality is only fair due to Dolby‑B artifacts and audience‑tape limitations; the mixed star scores and divergent reviewer comments support a moderate confidence level.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Dolby B encoded tape with a slight 'choked off' feeling, noticeable hiss and occasional muffling; decent for an audience recording when played back on a high‑end Nakamichi Dragon.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid flow highlighted by strong Terrapin/Althea sections and a crowd‑pleasing Peggy‑O; no major structural issues mentioned.
